name: Masquerade Field
description: Masquerade as users listed in a user field.
project_description:
This module extends Masquerade , by providing a user field referring other accounts that the user is able to masquerade as.

 Administrators, granted with administer users and edit masquerade field permission, are able to edit any user profile and select target accounts that the user being edited will be able to masquerade.

 Users granted with view own masquerade field are able to see this field in their account. The module provides a formatter that allows the user to masquerade, by clicking on the target user link.
